description: Land Title Settlement Department - Notice calling for claims to property of Intestate - Meerigama D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with land title registration and intestate property claims under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land parcel information including cadastral map numbers, parcel numbers, land extents, and certificate of title numbers. The notice calls for claims to intestate property and outlines the process for land title registration, making it clearly focused on land and property matters as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
